games.title: Noun Phrase Forge
games.skillName: Expanding noun phrases with adjectives, nouns and preposition phrases
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to develop their understanding of the concepts set out in English Appendix 2 by: noun phrases expanded by the addition of modifying adjectives, nouns and preposition phrases [for example, the teacher expanded to: the strict maths teacher with curly hair]
games.instruction: Read it, then tap the right answer.
games.hint: Not quite. Find the main noun first, then look at what describes it.

questions.ask: Which preposition phrase could expand 'the teacher'?
In 'the strict maths teacher', which noun is used to describe the teacher?
In 'the old oak tree by the river', what is the preposition phrase?
Which word is the main noun in 'the shiny bike in the shed'?
Which adjective could expand 'the ___ castle'?
Which noun phrase includes a preposition phrase?
In 'muddy football boots', which noun describes the boots?
Which phrase adds detail to 'the girl'?
Pick the best expanded noun phrase for a scary story.
In 'a tall glass of cold milk', which word is the main noun?

games.title: Pronoun Power-Up
games.skillName: Choosing nouns or pronouns for cohesion
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to choose nouns or pronouns appropriately for clarity and cohesion and to avoid repetition
games.instruction: Read it, then tap the word that makes it clearest.
games.hint: Not quite. Ask who or what the word stands for, then try again.

questions.ask: 'Tom fed the dog. Tom then walked the dog.' Best word for the second 'Tom'?
'The children ran outside. ___ were excited.'
'Mia found a coin. Mia kept the coin.' Best word for 'the coin'?
'Tom and Ali met Jo. He waved.' Why is 'He' unclear?
Which keeps it clear? 'Tom and Ali met Jo. ___ waved.'
'My grandma baked a cake. ___ was delicious.'
Which pronoun can replace 'Lucy and I' at the start of a sentence?
Which pronoun replaces 'the boys' in 'I saw the boys.'?
'The dragon roared. ___ breathed fire.' Which avoids repeating 'dragon'?
'Ben's sister lent Ben her bike.' Which word can replace the second 'Ben'?

games.title: Fact and Verse Finder
games.skillName: Finding facts and knowing poetry forms
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to retrieve and record information from non-fiction; recognise some different forms of poetry [for example, free verse, narrative poetry]
games.instruction: Read it, then tap the right answer.
games.hint: Not quite. Look back at the words in the text, then try again.

questions.ask: Text: 'Bees make honey from nectar.' What do bees use to make honey?
Text: 'Owls hunt at night and sleep by day.' When do owls hunt?
Text: 'Mount Everest is about 8,849 m tall.' How tall is it?
Text: 'Penguins live in the Southern Hemisphere.' Where do they live?
Which feature of a report helps you find facts quickly?
How many lines does a haiku have?
How many lines does a limerick have?
A poem with 14 lines is called a ___.
Which poem uses the first letter of each line to spell a word?
A narrative poem ___.
